of gauging, The shall be to the

flaw defecfion

4.3.1.1 Bolts and nuts of size M4 and larger shall detection to indicate any discontinuities, such as cracks,

be subjected to magnetic seams, inclusions, etc.

particle

flaw

4.3.1.2 The indication of discontinuities in ferro-magnetic bolts, such as cracks, seams and inclusions shall be determined by magnetic particle inspection in accordance with IS : 3703 - 1980 ' Code of practice for magnetic particle flaw detection ( firsf revision ) `. Such inspection shall in general be performed on finished bolts but, in any case, subsequent to any operations which could have any adverse effect. The magnetising field shall be parallel to the longitudinal axis of the bolt, primarily for the indication of transverse defects. Defects along the longitudinal axis of the bolt shall, however, be detected by circular magnetisation. Similar directions. . methods shall be applied for nuts to detect flaws in the transverse and
longitudinal

Demagnetisation 4.3.2 Penefranf

shall

be to the satisfaction of aluminium

of inspection

authority.

flaw defection

alloy bolfs and nufs

4.3.2.1 Finished aluminium alloy bolts and nuts shall be anodized according to relevant material specification. The bolts shall be examined after this treatment and the presence of any defects as indicated by chromic acid stains shall be accepted as cause for rejection. 4.3.2.2
bolts and

nuts

of Heat Treatment out on bolts which have been heat-treated in

5.6.1 Hardness and tensile tests shall be carried order to determine the uniformity of heat treatment.

5.6.2 Bolts of nominal size up to and including Ml6 shall be tensile tested for which a minimum All bolts of nominal size above Ml6 shall be cf ten finished bolts from each lot shall be taken. tested for hardness. 5.6.3 The tensile strength test shall be as follows:

An ordinary nut or its equivalent in the form of an adaptor shall be screwed on the bolt so as to be clear of the run-out of thread towards the head and also clear of any imperfect threads at the The load shall then be applied to the head and to the nut or adaptor.
